findings.reason: Verified that buildAuthorizationConditions always returns a Prisma.Sql (never null), so the filter-only and NOTHING branches in getBaseConditions are dead code; the claim is correct but only a cleanup concern.

Verified the constructor now takes the looser public type with optional teamId, so a team-scope caller without teamId compiles and silently gets 1=0 via safeParse; the runtime silence predates this PR, so the real change is only the lost compile-time check.

Verified the only integration test that executes the generated SQL uses scope "user", so org/team ANY(array) queries are untested against the database; the specific failure modes named (array typing, empty arrays) are speculative and unverified.

Verified the Caching describe block was deleted while the memoization fields remain, so cache behaviour is no longer tested; a valid test-coverage concern, though the removed tests did not directly exercise the null-vs-undefined edge the finding emphasises.
